name: plan-for-new-refusal-rule-untested-against-real-request-shapes-fails-planning-rounds
description: The plan for a new reading-refusal or matching rule designs its parser and matching rules from the accepted reading's wording without running them against real past request shapes (numbered forms, the standard Steward bullet), so the critic finds false-refusal and coverage gaps only after the last planning round and the job fails before any code.
